summary: deserialize_byte_buf incorrectly validates raw byte fields as UTF-8 through next_field(), rejecting invalid UTF-8 even for Vec<u8> fields annotated with serde_bytes. The fix uses next_field_bytes() to preserve arbitrary bytes. The regression test added by this commit deserializes a middle field containing foo\xFFbar and checks its exact bytes. This is a source-derived plan; no tests were executed.
expected_failure: called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value containing InvalidUtf8
